title: Two Men Died Over a Roll of Duct Tape #shorts
description:
November 5, 2005. A refinery in Delaware City, Delaware. A night-shift crew spots a roll of duct tape five feet down inside a reactor. The reactor is full of nitrogen. Nobody had put up a warning sign.

One man went in. His foreman went in after him. Neither came home.

If someone goes down in a tank: do not follow them in. Call for trained rescue.

This is an animated reconstruction. Every fact in it comes from the U.S. Chemical Safety Board's investigation:
Case Study 2006-02-I-DE, "Confined Space Entry - Worker and Would-be Rescuer Asphyxiated"
https://www.csb.gov/valero-delaware-city-refinery-asphyxiation-incident/

We tell these stories so no other family goes through this.
Don't die at work today.

Narration is an AI voice. The animation is a reconstruction, not footage.
